label: Truthy Gate
author: Conky-Studio
description: Outputs 1 if Input is non-zero / non-empty string, else 0. Universal 'is there a value?' bridge for LEDs and triggers.
lua_expr: (function() local v = {input}; if type(v) == 'number' then return (v ~= 0) and 1 or 0 end; local s = tostring(v or ''); return (s ~= '' and s ~= '0' and s ~= 'false' and s ~= 'nil') and 1 or 0 end)()
